description: This file defines the WebBridge class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class's interface, including nested classes, enums, member variables, and method signatures related to plugin management, WebSocket communication, and JSON-RPC message handling.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, dispatcher, and WebSocket interfaces, managing plugin lifecycle, message dispatching, and WebSocket communication.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, used for event subscription management.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Represents a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp, used for tracking pending requests.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for cleanup operations within WebBridge.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for WebBridge, including timeout and bind address settings.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket messages by identifier.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON-RPC messages by ID and element.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a specific version.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler for a given designator.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a channel to an event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a channel from an event.
